description: This PHP class defines a model for representing a reviewer in the Performance module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes metadata annotations for API documentation and uses traits to serialize data. The class constructs filters and attribute mappings for a Reviewer entity, primarily used for API responses involving reviewer data.

classes.name: ReviewerModel
classes.description: API data model representing a reviewer, with serialization filters and attribute mappings for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ReviewerModel with a Reviewer entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
